summary: SciSparc Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary NeuroThera Labs Inc. entered into an amendment to the Share Purchase Agreement to acquire CliniQuantum Ltd. The amendment sets a minimum deemed price of $0.05 per common share for earn-out shares and extends the closing date to June 1, 2026. The transaction remains subject to TSX Venture Exchange policies. No purchase price, premium, or advisor was disclosed in the amendment. The filing also notes conditional regulatory approval. Watch for completion by the extended deadline and any further regulatory or exchange conditions.
